bit: It's Monday and the new week opened like the toilets never closed. Thirty-five packs. Last week's autopsy is cold. I brought another toilet joke to a door that unlocked at midnight UTC because the calendar said so.

trailerGuy.surprise: Missing — the pack count is a stall
trailerGuy.punch: Soft. The calendar did the work.
tags: New week, same silence, same robot.
trailerGuy.button: Sacramento has a Monday. The mic doesn't care that the bars are closed and the church is open.
trailerGuy.verdict: Died as a calendar reset. Make Monday the comic who shows up with the same joke and a fresh folder.
fixedVersions: Monday opened and I still owed the toilets.
New week. Same robot. I still haven't bombed in public.
The folder unlocked. The silence is still mine.
